Runtime Composition and APIs
|-- [M] Composition boundary: choose concrete integrations, expose application behavior
|   |-- diagramApi(...) -> Vite plugin: new-diagram-api
|   |   `-- configureServer / configurePreviewServer -> same attach function
|   |-- createBackend(...) exposes
|   |   |-- routes.core and routes.mapping
|   |   |-- liveCanvas, diffSessionWorkflows, pushIntegrations
|   |   `-- dispose()
|   |-- Route factories receive services; concrete stores and runtimes are wired in bootstrap
|   |   |-- /api/core -> project source, catalog, representations, corpus compactions
|   |   `-- /api/mapping -> diagrams, workspace, agents, chat, changes, comparisons, evals
|   `-- Architecture tests constrain dependencies
|       |-- domain -> domain
|       |-- application -> application + domain
|       |-- infrastructure -> infrastructure + application + domain
|       |-- ordinary server -> server + application + domain
|       |-- bootstrap server -> also infrastructure
|       |-- UI source -> UI source + domain + packages
|       |-- Outside composition: targets must be non-composition and core or same owner
|       `-- Diagram construction and prepared content edits stay behind domain entry points
|-- [C] Startup: Vite configuration -> diagramApi(...) -> createBackend(...)
|   |-- [D] Configuration inputs
|   |   |-- projectRoot <- NEW_DIAGRAM_PROJECT_ROOT or two directories above app root
|   |   |-- diagramsDirectory <- NEW_DIAGRAMS_DIR or .diagrams
|   |   |-- domain profile <- valid NEW_DIAGRAM_DOMAIN, otherwise undefined
|   |   |-- mappingPocSourceRoot <- app root supplied by Vite configuration
|   |   `-- httpEnabled / piEnabled / lspEnabled <- respective global symbol flags === true
|   |-- Runtime selection
|   |   |-- NEW_DIAGRAM_AGENT == fake selects fake runtimes for
|   |   |   `-- local chat, selection, diagram edit, compaction, evals, comparisons
|   |   |-- Otherwise: Codex / Pi / AgentContext implementations receive piEnabled
|   |   |-- AgentChat still receives StdioCodexConnection; diff workflow still receives Pi runtime
|   |   `-- ProjectLanguageService exists only when lspEnabled === true
|   `-- Vite deployment settings
|       |-- Watcher ignores .diagrams* directories and configured storage root
|       |   `-- Application record writes should not trigger source reloads
|       `-- Preview allowedHosts <- trimmed, nonempty NEW_DIAGRAM_ALLOWED_HOSTS entries
|-- [O] Backend creates and retains a shared service graph
|   |-- Durable state and source access
|   |   |-- DiagramStore(projectRoot, diagramsDirectory) [shared store]
|   |   |   `-- Its storeRoot anchors file-backed repositories and JSON collections below
|   |   |-- corpusAccess = provider + readDocumentLines + discover
|   |   |-- CoreApplication <- shared store + corpusAccess
|   |   |-- ProjectSourceService <- shared store + corpusAccess + optional language service
|   |   |-- ProjectCatalogService <- shared store
|   |   `-- FileAgentContextSources [shared sources]
|   |       `-- [D] Resolve sourceId to corpus backing
|   |           |-- repo-* -> repositories.resolveCheckoutRoot -> git-worktree root
|   |           `-- Other sourceId -> loaded project + resolveDiagramSource -> binding().corpus
|   |               `-- No initialized project -> AGENT_CONTEXT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
|   |-- Canvas and agent collaboration
|   |   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge(CanvasSessionBridge) [shared bridge]
|   |   |-- AgentContextLibrary <- FileAgentContextRepository + shared sources
|   |   |-- AgentContextService <- context library
|   |   |-- FileDiagramAgentContextStore <- storeRoot + shared sources
|   |   |-- CanvasApiProjection [shared projection]
|   |   |-- MappingDiagramService <- shared store + corpus + project/profile + WorkspaceRecordStore
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService <- bridge list/context callbacks + contexts + shared projection
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService <- shared bridge + diagrams + shared store
|   |       |-- QuickJsAgentRuntime + diagram-edit runtime
|   |       |-- ChangeSessionService [shared changes]
|   |       `-- Context service + shared projection + diagram-context store
|   |-- Chat and change workflows
|   |   |-- AgentChatService <- StdioCodexConnection + FileChatStore + source root
|   |   |   |-- Live canvas + shared bridge + context library
|   |   |   `-- ChatDiagramTools(agent) + MappingChatMcpBinding(agent, process.cwd())
|   |   |-- ChangeSessionService <- DiagramChangeSessionStore + shared store + shared bridge
|   |   |-- DiffSessionWorkflowService <- shared changes + agent + PiDiffSessionRuntime
|   |   |   `-- FileDiffSessionRunStore + prompts + repository-backed source reader
|   |   |-- PushIntegrationService <- FilePushIntegrationStore + GitPushSource(repositories)
|   |   |   `-- Injected diff workflow; push service and diff workflow receive piEnabled
|   |   `-- LocalChatService <- shared store + corpusAccess + selected local-chat runtime
|   |-- Workspace, selection and compaction
|   |   |-- MappingWorkspaceService <- shared store + MappingWorkspaceStore + diagram contexts
|   |   |-- SelectionService <- shared store + selected mapping runtime + source root
|   |   `-- FileCompactionService <- core + selected runtime + FileCompactionStore
|   |       `-- Prompt loader and agent-settings resolver are injected
|   `-- Evaluation and comparison
|       |-- GeneratedCanvasCatalog <- shared store [shared catalog]
|       |-- CompareSessionService <- workspace + FileCompareSessionStore + catalog + shared store
|       |-- EvalReferenceService <- reference/group JSON stores + shared store
|       |-- EvalPromptService <- prompt/snapshot JSON stores + references + shared store
|       |-- EvalRunService <- compare sessions + workspace + shared store + context library
|       |   |-- Eval prompts + shared catalog + eval-run JSON store + selected eval runtime
|       |   |-- FileRollUpRunStore + FileCanvasTimeline
|       |   |-- LayoutTemplateService <- template JSON store + compare sessions + shared store
|       |   |-- ReferenceGenerationService <- session JSON store + agent chat + eval runs
|       |   |-- JudgementService <- judgement JSON store + compare sessions
|       |   |   `-- Comparison-run store + comparison generation + shared eval-run store
|       |   `-- ExperimentService <- experiment JSON store + eval runs + store + context library
|       |-- ComparisonGenerationService <- compare sessions + FileComparisonRunStore
|       |   `-- Selected comparison runtime
|       `-- [D] Shared results connected by callbacks
|           |-- Agent chat generation observations: children + parent + historical
|           |   `-- evalRuns.recordLegacy(...) reconciles generation records
|           |       `-- Observation rejection -> log Generation reconciliation failed
|           |-- Catalog snapshot(id, checkpoint) <- evalRuns.outputSnapshot(id, checkpoint)
|           |-- Eval legacy replay/cancel -> agentChat.rerunAlternatives / cancelGeneration
|           |-- Eval change-session lookup -> changes.get(id)
|           `-- Eval context-comparison deletion -> comparisonRuns.deleteContextOutputs(...)
|-- [C] Server attachment and request dispatch
|   |-- attach(server)
|   |   |-- Install HTTP middleware
|   |   `-- If httpServer exists: attach live-canvas sockets to backend.liveCanvas
|   |       `-- Context uploads and canvas writes enabled only by httpEnabled === true
|   |-- Incoming request -> parse URL
|   |   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next middleware
|   |   |-- Agent mutation + HTTP disabled + no x-canvas-chat-binding header
|   |   |   `-- 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED
|   |   |-- Not /api/<known namespace>/... -> 404
|   |   |   `-- /internal passes the prefix filter but has no dispatched namespace here
|   |   `-- Known namespace -> await routes.core or routes.mapping
|   |-- Core dispatch: /api/core/project/*
|   |   |-- GET files / source -> ProjectSourceService
|   |   |-- POST definitions -> ensureDefinitionsEnabled -> definitions(body, signal)
|   |   |   `-- [O] Request-local AbortController and response-close listener
|   |   |       |-- Premature response close -> abort work
|   |   |       |-- Send result only if response is not destroyed
|   |   |       `-- finally -> remove close listener
|   |   |-- POST projections -> catalog.saveProjection
|   |   |-- corpus-compactions -> require project
|   |   |   |-- GET -> catalog.compactions
|   |   |   `-- POST -> application.upsertProjectFileCompaction -> 201
|   |   `-- GET representations -> application.projectRepresentations(current or all)
|   |-- Mapping dispatch: /api/mapping/*
|   |   |-- Injected optional services enable delegated route groups
|   |   |   |-- generated-canvases / evals -> evaluation handlers
|   |   |   |-- comparison-runs / compare-sessions -> comparison handlers
|   |   |   |-- agent-chat / agent -> agent handlers
|   |   |   |-- integrations -> push handler, supplied NEW_DIAGRAM_PUSH_TOKEN
|   |   |   |-- workflows/diff-session-create -> diff workflow handler
|   |   |   `-- live/context/short / live/connections/:id/selection -> live reads
|   |   |-- compactions / chat -> dedicated compaction and local-chat handlers
|   |   |-- Workspace endpoints -> service calls; write bodies allow up to 64 MiB
|   |   |   |-- records: GET loadRecords; POST applyBatch
|   |   |   |-- workspace: GET load; PUT save
|   |   |   `-- export / import-contexts: POST portableExport / prepareImport
|   |   |-- Diagrams: POST save; POST publish checkpoint; DELETE by decoded ID
|   |   `-- POST prompt -> selection.prepare(body)
|   |       `-- Flush NDJSON headers -> selection.run(input, progress callback)
|   |           `-- Stream progress -> stream result -> end response
|   |-- Explicit method checks -> 405; unmatched routes -> 404
|   `-- Route exception -> transport translation
|       |-- Headers already sent -> send error event; end if still writable
|       `-- Headers not sent -> JSON error
|           |-- RequestTooLarge -> 413
|           |-- ProjectDiagramConflict / application conflict -> 409
|           |-- Application binary-source -> 415
|           |-- Application lsp-disabled / ai-disabled / storage-unavailable -> 503
|           |   `-- LSP/AI disabled also supplies LSP_DISABLED / AI_DISABLED code
|           `-- Application invalid-input or other thrown error -> 400
`-- [O] Shutdown owner: Vite adapter's httpServer close listener
    |-- Dispose socket attachment first
    `-- backend.dispose() invokes cleanup in source order
        |-- comparisonRuns -> evalRuns -> agentChat -> diffSessionWorkflows
        |-- agent -> diagramEditRuntime -> canvasBridge -> optional languageService
        `-- mappingRuntime -> chatRuntime -> compactionService
